title: List
description: Fiori list: standard / custom items, groups, selection modes (single, multiple, delete…), growing, roving focus.

usage.summary: Present a sequence of business items for browsing, navigation or selection without column comparison.
useWhen: Let users browse, navigate or select business items with a few attributes per item.
Group a flat collection without introducing expandable parent-child relationships.
Show standard item text and supporting attributes, or provide custom content for the same item task.
Use selectionMode="single" or "multiple" for choices and growing="button" or "scroll" with onLoadMore for incremental loading.

avoidWhen.when: Compare aligned row attributes: Table suits roughly 200 loaded rows of average complexity without built-in sorting; DataTable supplies sorting and virtualization, with a design rethink above 1,000.
Browse nested parent-child relationships that users must expand or collapse.
Choose one field value: Select covers 2–12 fixed options without typing (sort alphabetically above 8), and ComboBox covers type-ahead across 20–200.
Read events and changes to an object in chronological order.
Retain business-event updates with unread states and per-event actions rather than browse ordinary records.
